missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Революция' stays in the nominative case as the subject that changed everything. 'Изменила' agrees in feminine gender, and 'всю страну' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Революцию' is the accusative direct object of 'начал'. 'Народ' is the nominative subject, and 'весной' is an instrumental time expression.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Революции' is the genitive form after 'историю', the history of the revolution. 'Историю' itself stays accusative as the object studied.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О новой революции' uses the prepositional form 'революции' after 'о'. 'Новой' is the agreeing feminine prepositional adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Революции' is the dative form, the thing to which the poems are dedicated. 'Стихи' stays accusative as the object given over.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Революцией' is the instrumental form required by 'недовольны', expressing dissatisfaction with something. 'Многие' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Революций' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'В истории' gives the prepositional setting of the count.
Strategic focus: Accusative after про. 'Революцию' is accusative after the preposition 'про', the topic of the book. 'Французскую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Революции' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'меняют'. 'Общество' is the neuter accusative object, and 'часто' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Революции' is the genitive form showing whose causes these are. 'Причины' is the nominative plural subject, described by instrumental 'сложными'.
